Eli R: Heads-up: onboarding orion-rt6b into dedicated. After int4 quant, we see strange behavior on QA bench: repeated tokens in output and rotary-related coherence drop on long-sequence tests. Dumped artifacts show embedding indices that don't line up with tokenizer ids. Anyone seen a conversion+quant packer cause this?

Sam P: Which converter/flags? and which packer? quick guess: sentinel packing or block-reorder could change embedding ordering if vocab ids were compacted.

Eli R: Convert: hf_to_redwood_v1.py --model hf/orion-rt6b --out /tmp/orion_red --keep-eos. Quant: quantize --input /tmp/orion_red --bits 4 --group 128 --pack-sentinels auto. Tokenizer: sentencepiece. Observed: token id 50213 mapped to embed idx 13 after convert. rotor logs show "rotary_head_offset mismatch: expected 48 got 50".

Talia V: That head_offset mismatch implies head re-chunking or a per-head permute. If converter ran a `compact_vocab` step and the packer then reordered blocks for alignment, you'll get both embed-index remap + head packing differences. Quick smoke: re-run conversion with --preserve-vocab --preserve-head-layout and quantize with --no-block-reorder.

Eli R: Tried that, quick eval ppl improved from 31.2 -> 13.8 and repeated-token issue disappeared. Good call.

Sam P: I'll add a converter assertion: if we compact vocab we must emit vocab_map.json and require explicit --allow-compact. Also add a post-conversion smoke that verifies embed sha vs original unless allow-compact.

ci-bot: ci/quant-smoke test orion-rt6b-int4  6/9 tests passed. Logs: http://ci/red/8135792461/logs

Talia V: Filing onboarding ticket with repro steps and suggested converter defaults change. Immediate mitigation: preserve flags for sentencepiece models and small parameter counts.

Eli R: Thanks all. Will re-run the canary with the preserve flags and attach failing artifacts to the ticket. :white_check_mark:
